notes.title: “It is impossible… if they fall away”
notes.intro: A severe warning about those who have shared in the Holy Spirit and then fall away.

views.label: A real warning that believers can fall away
views.summary: Many traditions read this as showing a genuine believer can apostatise.
views.source: Methodist Articles of Religion, Article XII

views.label: A warning that shows who truly believes
views.summary: Reformed Christians often read it as describing people who tasted blessings without true conversion, or as a means God uses to keep believers persevering.
